title: Enhance volumetric clouds system with precomputed density, 3D AO and shadow transmittance
abstract:
This change introduces major enhancements to the volumetric clouds system. 

1. The 3D volume bake shader (`cloud_3d_volume_bake.comp`) is updated to compute the physical evaluated cloud density (with full weather map, advection, advection offset, and noise detailing) at each voxel's Earth-curved world-space coordinate and store it in both the baseAlbedo (B) and baseDensity (A) channels of the 3D texture.
2. The shadow bake shader (`cloud_shadow_bake.comp`) is updated to populate the local ambient occlusion (G channel) based on neighbor evaluated densities from the A channel, and march towards the sun (`u_primaryLightDir`) to compute voxel-specific shadow transmittance (B channel). This is processed in a performance-optimal, staggered 2x2 Bayer-aligned fashion.
3. The minimal cloud density function `calculateCloudDensityMinimal` inside `clouds.glsl` is optimized to directly sample the baked density and AO from the 3D texture instead of procedurally evaluating noise and density, leading to massive performance gains.
4. The CPU-side manager (`AtmosphereManager`) is updated to bind the 3D volume texture to read-write image unit 1 and set/bind the necessary uniforms and textures during shadow bake.
5. All shaders are preprocessed and validated using `make glcheck` with zero compilation warnings or errors.
